title: SII Vol. 14 No. 26 — Ramanathapuram
location_detail: On a rock in the village
summary: This Tamil inscription, which does not quote the regnal year of the king, states that Nakkan-pullan who had the other name of Parantaka-ppallivelan had accompanied king Maranjadaiyan in his campaign (yattirai) against Idavai in Sola-nadu

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 27 — Ambasamudram
location_detail: On a slab set up in front of the Tirumulanatha temple
summary: This damaged Vatteluttu record of Maranjadaiyan is defaced at the placed where the regnal year is cited; but it appears probable that only one year and not a double year has been mentioned

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 28 — Tiruchchatturai
location_detail: On the west wall of the Odanavanesvara temple
summary: This damaged inscription registers a gift of 300 kasu by Pandi-Marajar Vraguna-Marajar for burning a sacred lamp in the tempe of Tiruchchorrutturai-Mahadeva

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 29 — Perungulam
location_detail: On the south side of the Ardhamandapa in the Tiruvaludisvara temple
summary: This damaged record, probably of [Maranjadi]yan, who is apparently the king mentioned in the first line, appears to register a gift of sheep by some one of Elur, whose name is lost, for a lamp in the temple

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 30 — Kudumiyamalai
location_detail: On a pillar in the Melaikoyil temple
date_text: This record of Maranjadaiyan is dated in the 23rd year of his reign
summary: Owing to the damaged condition of the letters, it is not possible to make out the contents of the record

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 31 — Kalgumalai
location_detail: On a slab in the Kosakkudi street
summary: This record dated in the 23rd year of the reign of Maranjadaiyan from Kalugumalai is of interest as it mentions an expedition of the Pandya army against Sadaiyan-Karunandan of Malai-nadu, in which the fort of Ariviyur was destroyed

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 32 — Pallimadam
location_detail: On the wing-stone at the entrance of the Kalanathasvamin temple
summary: This Vatteluttu inscription dated in the 26th year of the reign of Maranjadaiyan appears to register a gift of 100 sheep by Sa[tta]n-Gunattan of Kunnur in [Karu]-nilakkudi-nadu for supplying ghee to a deity in the temple of Tirukkattamballi at Kurandi

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 33 — Pallimadam
location_detail: On the north base of the Kalanathasvamin temple
summary: This Vatteluttu record, which is dated in the 26th regnal year of an unspecified king, may be assigned to Maranjadaiyan whose inscription dated in the same regnal year is found in this temple

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 36 — Ambasamudram
location_detail: On the door-jambs of the Erichchavudaiyar temple
summary: This inscription in Vatteluttu characters is dated in the 35th year of the reign of a king whose name is not mentioned; but he may be assumed to be identical with the Maranjadaiyan of whom high regnal years have been found

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 37 — Manur
location_detail: On one of the pillars in The Ambalavana temple
summary: This inscription dated in the 35th year and 469th day of the reign of Maranjadaiyan is of interest as giving the rules land qualifications which governed the admission of members to the assembly of Mananilainallur, a brahmadeya in Kalakkudi-nadu, and the penalty imposed on those who transgressed the

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 38 — Ambasamudram
location_detail: On a slab in the Prakara of the erichchavudaiyar temple
summary: This inscription is dated in the 39th year of the reign of an unspecified king and may be attributed to king Maranjadaiyan, whose record (No. 36) dated in the 35th year has been published above

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 39 — Pallimadam
location_detail: On the stone at the entrance to the Kalanathasvamin temple
summary: This inscription is dated in the 6th year opposite to the 35th year of Maranjadaiyan and refers to the gift of sheep to Tirukkattamballi at Kurandi in Venbunadu

location_detail: above is engraved

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 40 — Dalapatisamudram
location_detail: On a slab lying in a field in the Parachcheri of the village
summary: This long inscription in Vatteluttu characters is dated in the 6th year opposite to the 35th year of the reign of king Maranjadaiyan who appears to be identical with the king figuring in

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 37
location_detail: above from Manur, dated in the 35th year and 469th day
summary: The record consists of two separate endowments made by a certain Velan of Irambadu in Karaikana-nadu

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 41 — Eruvadi
location_detail: On a Boulder in the Irattaippottai rock
date_text: This record dated in the 43rd year of the reign of Maranjadaiyan comes from Eruvadi
summary: This is the highest regnal year found for Maranjadaiyan for whom records in the 35th and 39th years have been found elsewhere

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 42 — Kalugumalai
location_detail: On the rock within the Ayyanar temple on the hill
summary: This record dated in the 7th year opposite to the 35th year of the reign of Maranjadaiyan registers a gift of gold by a brahmana named Mani Sankaranarayanan, a nagarattan of Tiruchuriyal for burning a lamp during the three services in the shrine of the Devar which he had made

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 43 — Erukkangudi
location_detail: On a rock in a field to the south of the tank in the village
summary: This Vatteluttu inscription of the 16th regnal year of Sadaiya-Maran states that Iruppaikkudi-Kilavan dismantled the old bund of the tank, strengthened it with stone and renovated a specified length of the bund

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 44 — Erukkangudi
location_detail: On a slab on the bund of the tank in the village
summary: This long Vatteluttu inscription in Tamil verse is stated to have been engraved in the 18th year of the reign of the Pandya king Sadaiya-Maran who has been called also Srivallabhan

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 45 — Sittannavasal
location_detail: On the rock south of the rock-cut Jaina temple
summary: This inscription in Tamil verse, which is engraved in early characters with the pulli marked for the basic consonants, refers to the Pandya king Srivalluvan (i.e., Srivallabha), who had the title Avanipasekharan

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 46 — Pallimadam
location_detail: On the north wall of the Kalanathasvamin temple
summary: This record of the 2nd year of Sadaiya-Maran is slightly damaged in the middle and appears to register a gift of 25 sheep for the maintenance of a lamp in the temple of Sundarapandya-Isvara-Devar at Tiruchchuriyal, a devadana in Parttikkudi-nadu by a carpenter of Kalisalmangalam, a brahmadeya in Ala

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 47 — Perungulam
location_detail: On the south side of the entrance into the Ardhamandapa of the
summary: This damaged record of the 2nd year of Sadaiya-Maran refers to a gift of a perpetual lamp by the son-in-la o Tayanjattan, a Vellala of Pallip-Perumbulingavu in Tinaikkalamangalam, a village in Kuda-nadu to the god Tiruvaludisvarattu-Alvar at Perungulam in Tiruvaludi-valanadu

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 48 — Madurai
location_detail: On two slabs in the Madanagopalasvamin temple
date_text: It is dated in the 2 + 1st year of Sadaiya-Maran and probably belongs to the time of Rajasimha
summary: This Vatteluttu inscription was found engraved on two slabs in the compound of the Madangopala temple at Madurai

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 49 — Tirukkottiyur
location_detail: On a slab in the store-room of the Samyanarayana-Perumal temple
date_text: This Vatteluttu record which is let into the wall of the store-room and is kept bottom up, is dated in the 2 + 1st year of Sadiya-Maran
summary: The secondary loop is attached to the top of the respective consonants and not to the side

title: SII Vol. 14 No. 50 — Kudimiyamalai
location_detail: On a pillar in the rock-cut cave temple
summary: No. 238 of 1911), dated in the 2 + 1 + 1st year of the reign of Sadaiya-Maran registers a gift of gold by Parantaka-Adalaiyur-nadalvan alias Kadamban-Etti for burning a lamp in the temple of Tirumulattanattu-Mahadeva at Tirunilakkunram, a devadana in Kunriyur-nadu
